set.body:
Freeze the current exact-affine HalfFlow-LM implementation as the named control before changing optimizer behavior.

Acceptance gate:
- Record the current configuration, schedules, seeds, native input hashes, supplied affine, optimization masks, held-out labels, relevant commits, and frozen receipts, including docs/benchmarks/receipts/half-flow-factored-affine-p7-2026-07-22.json.
- Predeclare lanes A-E, shared inputs, comparable accepted-step budgets, output paths, and a machine-readable result schema.
- The schema records objective values, global/local CC, internal-label Dice or surface distance, TRE when present, active-support and edge-band fractions, det-J distribution and folds, inverse-error interior percentiles and maxima, controller histories, rejection/retry reasons, runtime, allocations where available, and peak RSS.
- Record ANTs image ID/digest, profile, seed, thread count, supplied-affine policy, and linux/amd64 emulation. Runtime is labeled as this comparator class.
- Optimization inputs are distinguished from evaluation-only masks and labels; no held-out moving mask or label may enter the objective.
- No architecture or parity conclusion is drawn from the single sub18 pair.
set.title: HalfFlow-CC G0: freeze controls, lanes, and evidence schema
